title: All It Takes Is a Headline
summary: Stocks were meandering around the unchanged line for most of the morning. Then, just as I was finishing a meeting and getting ready to type out this piece, I noticed that major indices surged a bit higher as oil futures dipped. It didn’t take long to figure out why – at 11:17, Reuters reported, “Pakistan, Iran explore path towards new talks with US in a China-initiated push, sources say.” That was enough to improve the market’s mood, at least for the time it took me to write this.
